name: Dune
author: Erin Carter
description: A sand sea from directly above at night: long sinuous crest lines lit asymmetrically, a bright moonlit windward face falling off into a short dark slip face. The whole ridge system translates and reshapes downwind with geological patience.

params.label: Wind
params.effect: Downwind transport and reshaping rate of the ridge system; 0 becalms the sand entirely.

params.label: Crest spacing
params.effect: Ridge wavelength in CSS pixels, from fine ripple sand to vast widely-spaced draa.

params.label: Relief
params.effect: Asymmetry strength between lit and slip faces; low flattens crests to faint lines, high cuts deep moonlit relief.
